# Oakville, ON— 2000 Federal Election Results Map
### Oakville — 2000 Election Results
📌 The Canadian federal electoral district of Oakville was contested in the 2000 election.
🏆 M.A. Brown, the Liberal candidate, won the riding with 23,074 votes (47.7% of the vote).
🥈 The runner-up was Dan Ferrone (Canadian Alliance) with 13,544 votes (28.0%), defeated by a margin of 9,530 votes.
📊 Other notable candidates: Rick Byers (Progressive Conservative, 20%).
